title: Kessen arrives on PlayStation 2

blocks.text: In 2000, Kessen became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Kessen broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
